about: Arcoxia (etoricoxib) 60 mg is supplied five times from April to July 2026 to a 69-year-old man, by brand name only.
Celecoxib 200 mg is supplied three times from January to March 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history of a 73-year-old woman.
Celebrex (celecoxib) 200 mg is supplied four times from March to June 2026, but the patient is a 57-year-old, below the older-person age of 65, so the criterion is not met.
